tasks.short: Pay winnings or collect losing bets by the game rules.

steps.what: Read the game rules on the finished layout
Name rank, suit and seat for this hand
Draft the unsaved payout from the marked hand
Check the payout is the winnings the rules require
Pay winnings or collect the losing bets in chips
Hold the chips and call the floor on a dispute

tasks.design: The dealer marks rank, suit and seat for the finished hand. The {OTHER} settlement unit drafts an unsaved chip amount from the fixed rules and stops. She checks that the amount is the winnings those rules require, then pays or collects the chips herself. Nothing is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Payout rules sat in her head and varied by game, so each hand was worked out at the layout.
tasks.enabler_now: The rules of a specific game are fixed, and a short deterministic draft from a marked hand is cheap.
tasks.still_hard: A disputed hand, a misdeal, and any bet the rules do not price.
tasks.human_edge: She alone pays a disputed hand and calls the floor.
tasks.altitude: Her week still spends most of its time moving chips. She no longer works the arithmetic on a hand the unit can price. She does not gain the right to pay a dispute without the floor.

reach.role: Gambling and Sports Book Writers and Runners
reach.learn: The rules draft the amount, the person still pays, and a dispute stays with staff.

evidence.claim: Fixed game rules can draft a chip amount from rank, suit and seat. A disputed hand still needs the dealer.
If a table system measures dealer speed or errors, works-council consent is needed under WOR article 27.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the hand is finished and ends when the chips have moved. Dealing the hand is another task.
The structured input is rank, suit and seat, produced in s2, and that capture time stays in s2. The unit does not ask her to type the hand again.
If a hand has no rank, she prices that bet by hand inside the check, which keeps its full share. She does not maintain the rules, so incremental hours are zero.
The unit drafts an unsaved amount and stops. It does not file a payout and it does not pay the player. There is no gate on a plain save, because nothing is stored.
The pay stays in the room, so the prior act_external label is set aside. A per-hand approval is also set aside: she checks the amount, then moves the chips.
The unit is not used to measure her speed or her errors. Attraction-kiosk figures are not used.
unknowns: Whether this house's tables have a reading unit. If not, she marks the hand herself, which s2 already counts.
research_questions: Which side bets on this house's layouts have a fixed price, and which does she still price by hand?

already_counted.description: She still checks the chip amount against the rules before she pays.

incremental.description: Unpriced bets are priced inside the check, which keeps its full share. She does not maintain the rules, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A standard hand the unit prices leaves about 10. A layout with several unpriced side bets, which she still prices inside the check, leaves about 5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Exchange paper currency for playing chips or coin money.

steps.what: Take the paper currency or the coin money
Count the currency and judge the notes are genuine
Hand over the playing chips for that money
Write this chip exchange once in the table record

tasks.design: She takes the notes, counts them, and judges they are genuine. She hands over the playing chips. She writes the exchange once in the table record. No second copy is made, and she does not approve her own line.
tasks.previous_blocker: The count, the genuine-note judgement, and the hand-over are physical work at the table.
tasks.enabler_now: Leaving the exchange manual is the design. A second filing would not shorten the count or the hand-over.
tasks.still_hard: A note that feels wrong, a short count, and a patron who changes the amount while she counts.
tasks.human_edge: She alone judges the notes and hands the chips.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still counts the notes, hands the chips, and writes the exchange once.

reach.learn: The count and the hand-over stay in their hands, and the line is written once.

evidence.claim: Counting notes and handing chips is physical work. A second filing of the exchange would not remove that work.
If a table system measures dealer speed or errors, works-council consent is needed under WOR article 27.

assumptions: The exchange stays in the room. The prior act_external label is set aside. She is not sending anything outside the organisation.
The exchange line is her own record of a count she just made. The cashier is not sent a second copy from here, so there is no gate and no machine filing.
Nothing was added, so incremental hours are zero. The line is not used as a score of her speed.
unknowns: Whether this house writes an exchange line or only calls the amount out.
research_questions: Does the pit reconstruct a buy-in from this line, or only from the chip tray at the end of the shift?

incremental.description: Nothing was added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The count, the genuine-note judgement, the chip hand-over, and the one written line all stay. A quiet buy-in and a disputed note both leave 0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Receive, verify and record patrons' cash wagers.

steps.what: Receive patrons' cash wagers at the table
Verify the wager is allowed and accept the amount
Tell the patron the accepted wager is on
Record the accepted cash wager in the table book

tasks.design: She receives the cash and verifies the wager is allowed. That check produces the amount, the game and the seat. The {OTHER} table book then records only that accepted wager, which is the record she writes by hand today. She does not write the same line again. The pit uses the book to reconstruct the bet, so the commit is gated on the accepted version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each wager was a different amount written by hand between hands.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she has accepted the amount, the game and the seat, copying those three fields is deterministic.
tasks.still_hard: A patron who changes the wager while she counts, and a wager the game does not allow.
tasks.human_edge: She alone accepts or refuses the wager.
tasks.altitude: She still takes and verifies every cash wager. She no longer copies the accepted wager into the book by hand.

reach.role: Gambling and Sports Book Writers and Runners
reach.learn: Verify the wager first, then one commit of the accepted wager. Do not keep a second handwritten copy.

evidence.claim: Copying an accepted amount, game and seat into the table book is deterministic. Judging whether a cash wager is allowed is not.
If a table system measures dealer speed or errors, works-council consent is needed under WOR article 27.
Staff must be trained to recognise addiction, signs of excessive play must be recorded, and every player must be checked in Cruks before play.

assumptions: Recording the cash wager is work she does today. The machine step replaces that write. She does not also write the line at full remaining time.
The gate sits on the commit into the table book the pit uses to reconstruct the bet. It is not a self-approval of a note she already stored.
Amount, game and seat are produced in the verify step. That capture time is the full verify share. The book does not ask her to type them again.
When the cash does not match the call, she re-verifies and the commit is repeated. Those exception hours are the incremental 3, not a second standing write.
The book is not used to measure her speed or her errors. Cruks checks and addiction signals stay a separate duty and are not absorbed here.
Telling the patron stays in the room, so it is not an external send.
unknowns: Whether cash wagers are recorded per bet or only as a drop total.
research_questions: Which fields does the pit actually use to reconstruct a cash wager: amount, game and seat, or only the drop?

already_counted.description: She still verifies every cash wager before it is recorded.

incremental.description: When the cash does not match the call, she re-verifies and the commit is repeated.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A single accepted wager that matches the call leaves about 12. Mixed notes and a voided line she re-enters leave about 6. The 3 re-entry hours are already off the central 18, so this range sits under the net.

tasks.short: Supervise staff and monitor tables for game security.

steps.what: Monitor the gambling tables and the staff dealing
Judge whether security of the game still holds
Correct the staff or stop the game in the room
Write one security note herself when play stopped

tasks.design: She watches the tables and the staff, and judges whether the game is still secure. She corrects staff or stops play in the room. When play stops she writes one security note herself. There is no screen, no second filing, and no approval of that note.
tasks.previous_blocker: Security is a live judgement of people, not a form.
tasks.enabler_now: Leaving the watch manual is the design. A screen would not shorten looking at the table.
tasks.still_hard: Collusion, and a subtle chip move a later note cannot reconstruct.
tasks.human_edge: She alone decides the game is no longer secure.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still watches the tables and corrects staff in the room.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Gambling Services Workers
reach.learn: The watch stays theirs. They do not take a speed score from the table record.

evidence.claim: Watching the floor and judging whether the game is still secure is not shortened by a screen.
If a table system measures dealer speed or errors, works-council consent is needed under WOR article 27.

assumptions: The opening look is the only read. Directing staff and the note are writes. The prior read label on the correction is set aside.
No dashboard is built. The wager record and the settlement unit are not used to time her or count her errors.
The security note is her own write of a stop she just made. Nobody else relies on a second copy from here, so there is no gate and no machine filing.
Nothing is built, so incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Whether a dealer in this house supervises other staff or only watches her own table.
research_questions: When play stops, does this house expect a note from the dealer, or only a call to the floor supervisor?

incremental.description: Nothing is built, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A quiet shift and a stopped game both leave the watch, the judgement, the correction, and her own note. Both leave 0.

role.altitude: The payout figure is shown and the accepted cash wager is recorded. She still moves the chips, still counts the notes, still accepts each wager, and still watches the tables. She can reject a payout that does not match the layout and refuse a wager the game does not allow.
reach: Gambling and Sports Book Writers and Runners
First-Line Supervisors of Gambling Services Workers
skills_to_grow: Reject a payout the rules do not support, including a side bet the unit did not price.
Keep the currency count and the chip hand-over, and write the exchange once.
Accept a cash wager only after the amount and the game match, and do not keep a second copy.
Watch the table herself, and do not treat a record as a score of her speed.
role.ambitious_version: The accepted payout is drafted for her and she pays it. The cash wager she accepted is recorded once. The chip exchange, the dispute, and the watch stay hers.
